tips_en: Start with Paper 1 (VGI-Bench) as it provides the clearest diagnostic framing of current video generation models' reasoning failures, revealing that even top models like Seedance 2.0 reach only 51% and exhibit less than 1% self-correction during denoising. Then read Paper 3 (VBVR-Pro), which directly extends the VBVR line of work into a trainable framework with verifiable rewards and shows meaningful gains (0.290 average improvement, up to 20pp transfer). Paper 2 (PAWBench) is best read last, as it offers a complementary distributional perspective on world modeling that contrasts with Paper 1's single-rollout evaluation—together the three papers paint a cohesive picture of where video reasoning evaluation stands and where it should go next.
tips_zh: 建议先读论文 1（VGI-Bench），它清晰地诊断了当前视频生成模型的推理缺陷：即使是最强的 Seedance 2.0 也仅达到 51%，且去噪过程中的自我纠错率不足 1%。接着读论文 3（VBVR-Pro），该工作直接扩展了 VBVR 系列，构建了可训练的可验证奖励框架，取得了 0.290 的平均提升和最高 20 个百分点的迁移增益。论文 2（PAWBench）适合最后阅读，它从分布对齐的角度补充了世界建模的视角，与论文 1 的单轨迹评估形成对比——三篇论文共同勾勒出视频推理评估的现状与未来方向。
